Indian Parliament Monsoon Session Ends Amid Disruptions and Bill Passage

India's Parliament concluded its monsoon session with both the Lok Sabha and Rajya Sabha adjourned sine die. The session, which began on July 20, was marked by significant disruptions, protests, and sloganeering from the opposition. Despite the turmoil, 12 bills were passed in the Lok Sabha, with the government stating it was ready to debate all issues and blaming the opposition for the disruptions. The opposition rejected a proposal for a 24-hour discussion on the July 20 incident, and some bills were passed without debate amid the ruckus.
